A Festschrift for Rodolphe

Scholarly contributions on the occasion of his 60th birthday

About the volume

This collection is intended to bring together mathematical ideas, research perspectives and open questions connected with Rodolphe’s work. Contributions may develop a scientific result, revisit a shared problem, or explain how an idea has travelled between fields.

Nonlinear control, geometry, optimisation, collective dynamics and biological rhythms provide possible starting points. The purpose is to make the science—and the questions still ahead—available as a lasting academic record.

Contributions

Manuscripts will be listed here with their authors, abstracts and downloadable papers as they are received. No submitted contributions are available yet.

Preparing a contribution

A contribution should include a title, author names and affiliations, an abstract, the main text and references. A short note or a longer article is welcome in this draft format; length, editorial process and deadlines will be agreed by the organisers.
